instruction: Buy me any sweater in my size on amazon. Assure from QAs/reviews that no one has reported its color fading after washing. Obtain my size from any of my past sweater orders.
notes: Fix: the object formerly named home-address clashed with the predicate of the same name; the predicate is now is-home-address and the object is eric-home-address (all other names are unique across types, predicates, constants and objects). Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. Size discovery is a chain: show_product_purchases reveals a past sweater, show_product on it yields relative_size (found-size), which gates search_products with the relative_size filter. The 'no color fading after washing' assurance is modeled as knowledge predicates qa-checked and reviews-checked produced by show_product_questions and show_product_reviews on the candidate; at runtime the agent reads them (using show_product_question_answers for fading-related questions if needed) and, if a report exists, repeats search/check with the next candidate. add_product_to_cart uses quantity=1 and clear_cart_first=true so the order has exactly one unit of one product. The order must ship to the supervisor's home address, so supervisor.show_addresses gates selecting the matching amazon address id; no addresses are added or updated. supervisor-complete-task takes the order record parameters (non-API) so its precondition equals the goal, is gated by (not (task-completed)), and is the only action producing (task-completed).
